minigames.title: Twin-Stick Barcode Blaster
minigames.description: Suburban shoppers are charging the checkout registers. Tag items with your high-frequency laser scanner before they breach the counter!

blurbOnTier.FLAWLESS: Rapid-fire scanner masterclass! You cleared sixty items a minute and gave zero unearned discounts.
blurbOnTier.SOLID: Clean register throughput. A coupon lady grumbled, but your checkout line kept moving.
blurbOnTier.CLUMSY: A toddler knocked over a battery display and your laser scanner threw three price check errors.
blurbOnTier.DISASTER: A cart crashed into register four, the scanner glass shattered, and Todd wrote you up on the spot.

minigames.title: The Pallet Haul / Aisle Dodger
minigames.description: Haul a 2,000-lb hydraulic pallet jack down narrow grocery aisles. Dodge spills, caution cones, and wandering shoppers without tipping freight!

blurbOnTier.FLAWLESS: Precision pallet navigation! Not a single box wobbled, and you slipped past toddlers like a ghost.
blurbOnTier.SOLID: Solid freight delivery. You had to honk the horn twice at cereal gazers, but the cargo arrived intact.
blurbOnTier.CLUMSY: A sharp turn threw two cases of marinara into Aisle 6. You spent half an hour mopping crushed tomatoes.
blurbOnTier.DISASTER: The pallet jack jackknifed into an endcap display of cooking oil. Management called an all-hands spill response.

minigames.title: The Baler Compactor
minigames.description: Compress hundreds of corrugated boxes in the industrial green baler. Reject illegal plastics and tie off the four steel wires before safety switches trip!

blurbOnTier.FLAWLESS: Textbook hydraulic baling! Every wire looped clean and tight; Mack gave a rare nod of grudging respect.
blurbOnTier.SOLID: Bale compressed and stacked without issue. Solid backroom hustle.
blurbOnTier.CLUMSY: A stray plastic wrap jammed the intake chute for ten minutes while the motor whined in agony.
blurbOnTier.DISASTER: A steel pipe slipped into the chamber, snapping a guide rod with an ear-shattering bang. Clint is reviewing the CCTV.

minigames.title: Counter Commotion
minigames.description: Serve high-maintenance customers at the specialty counter. Shave deli meats to exact ounce targets, find display case keys, and pitch extended warranties!

blurbOnTier.FLAWLESS: Flawless service precision! Every slice hit the exact ounce mark and you upsold three extended warranties.
blurbOnTier.SOLID: Steady counter performance. Customers walked away satisfied with their barcodes and cuts.
blurbOnTier.CLUMSY: You fumbled the glass case key ring for forty seconds while a customer loudly tapped their watch.
blurbOnTier.DISASTER: You sliced double the customer's prosciutto order and dropped a showroom phone on the tile floor.

minigames.title: Cart Corral Rush
minigames.description: Wrangle a serpentine snake of 30 runaway shopping carts across the asphalt lot through hail and erratic parking lot SUVs!

blurbOnTier.FLAWLESS: You snapped the cart strap with one hand and wheeled thirty carts into the bay without tapping a single bumper.
blurbOnTier.SOLID: Cart bay replenished. A light rain started, but the entrance vestibule is fully stocked.
blurbOnTier.CLUMSY: The cart train jackknifed across two handicapped spaces. A minivan laid on the horn.
blurbOnTier.DISASTER: Four runaway carts rolled downhill into an assistant district manager's Lexus. Total disaster.
